# Version 4.150.8 (Unreleased)
> **Region and texture reliability**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.150.8 update fixes region allocation and OpenGL texture sampling without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safe conic region allocation** — Region construction budgets scanline storage for subdivided conics and rejects accumulation overflow, preventing an undersized buffer and out-of-bounds writes. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
- **Correct OpenGL texture boundaries** — Disable GLES-invalid BGRA-as-RGBx upload capabilities and preserve nearest-filtered texture subset clamps when magnification or fractional mappings could sample neighboring texels. One-to-one integer-relative mappings retain their fast path. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
